|ingredients = {{Name|Rhubarb|1}}{{Name|Wheat Flour|1}}{{Name|Sugar|1}} |sellprice = 400 |edibility = 86 }} '''Rhubarb Pie''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. '''Note:''' this recipe is [[Cooking#Profitable Recipes|profitable]] - it will result in profit when using the lowest quality rhubarb as well as wheat flour and sugar from the [[Mill]]. Rhubarb Pie may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]], in the [[Garbage Can]] outside the saloon, or in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]'s rotating stock. One Rhubarb Pie may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Robin,Demetrius,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Sandy |love=Maru,Jodi |dislike=Harvey,Willy,Krobus,Leo }} ==Bundles== Rhubarb Pie is not used in any [[Bundles|bundles]]. ==Recipes== Rhubarb Pie is not used in any recipes. ==Tailoring== Rhubarb Pie is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[Tailoring|Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt063.png|24px]] It can also be used as a red dye in the dye pots, located in [[Haley]]'s and [[Emily]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== Rhubarb Pie is not used in any [[Quests|quests]]. ==History== {{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].
